claim_selector.purpose: Select the concrete paper result row already covered by the local native reproduction runner.

sources.content: Table 2 column order is Linear MSE/MAE, NLinear MSE/MAE, DLinear MSE/MAE, followed by compared methods. The selected row is: Exchange 96 45.27% 0.082 0.207 0.089 0.208 0.081 0.203. Therefore the selected DLinear Exchange-Rate prediction-length-96 result is MSE 0.081 and MAE 0.203.

seq_len=336
model_name=DLinear
python -u run_longExp.py --is_training 1 --root_path ./dataset/ --data_path exchange_rate.csv --model_id Exchange_${seq_len}_96 --model ${model_name} --data custom --features M --seq_len ${seq_len} --pred_len 96 --enc_in 8 --des Exp --itr 1 --batch_size 8 --learning_rate 0.0005

fix_seed = 2021; random.seed(fix_seed); torch.manual_seed(fix_seed); np.random.seed(fix_seed). Defaults: train_epochs=10, patience=3, loss=mse, lradj=type1, use_amp=False. The exchange script overrides batch_size=8 and learning_rate=0.0005.

Dataset_Custom computes num_train=int(len(df_raw)*0.7), num_test=int(len(df_raw)*0.2), num_vali=len(df_raw)-num_train-num_test. Borders are [0, num_train-seq_len, len(df_raw)-num_test-seq_len] to [num_train, num_train+num_vali, len(df_raw)]. StandardScaler is fitted only on df_data[0:num_train], then transforms all rows.

DLinear uses series decomposition with moving-average kernel_size=25. With individual=False it creates one shared Linear_Seasonal(seq_len,pred_len) and one shared Linear_Trend(seq_len,pred_len), applies them to seasonal and trend components, and sums the outputs.

Training uses optim.Adam(self.model.parameters(), lr=self.args.learning_rate) and nn.MSELoss(). Testing concatenates all prediction and truth batches, reshapes them to (-1, pred_len, channels), and calls metric(preds, trues), whose MSE and MAE aggregate over all test windows, prediction steps, and channels.

Frozen local Exchange-Rate benchmark: 7,588 rows, 8 daily exchange-rate channels, date range 1990-01-01 through 2016-11-10. CSV columns are date, Australia, British, Canada, Switzerland, China, Japan, New Zealand, Singapore.
